title: Call Me By Your Name

vibeProfile.oneLine: One golden Italian summer, and a first love that marks a life.

summary: Over one golden summer on the Italian Riviera, seventeen-year-old Elio falls, consumingly, for Oliver, the older American scholar staying with his family, and the two circle each other through longing, hesitation and a brief, intense union that will mark them for life. Aciman's novel is a swooning, sensuous study of first love and desire, written in long, aching sentences and lit by sun, fruit and the sea. A modern classic of romance, tender and unbearably wistful.
whyReadIt: A swooning, sun-drenched novel of first love that aches for years afterward. The most romantic book on the shelf.

funFacts.text: Its film adaptation won an Academy Award for Best Adapted Screenplay.
